title: Auditing
description: Audit data changes with triggers and pgaudit.

data.text: Use pgaudit for SQL-level auditing. Use triggers for row-level auditing.

data.title: Audit Trigger
data.code:
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  table_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  changed_by TEXT NOT NULL
);

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use pgaudit for comprehensive SQL auditing.
